# Pyodide runtime

Pinned to **314.0.8**, downloaded from the [official documented CDN](https://pyodide.org/en/stable/usage/downloading-and-deploying.html). `sources.json` records download URLs, byte counts and SHA-256. The loader, WebAssembly binary, JavaScript glue, Python standard library and package lock are served from our own Pages site; the game does not depend on a separate runtime CDN after deployment.

The upstream [Mozilla Public License 2.0](LICENSE) is retained verbatim from [the matching release](https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/blob/314.0.8/LICENSE). Upstream source: <https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/314.0.8>. These files are unmodified; game code remains under the project's own terms.
